BRING YOUR CURIOSITY

Leave the route
better marked.

Small, reproducible improvements help the next person.

Browse issues
  1. 01

    Try the documented path.

    Use a disposable fresh VPS. Record Android version, release, the failing step and what you expected.

  2. 02

    Report with care.

    Remove credentials, server addresses, keys, certificate identities and private logs before opening a public issue. Read the security policy for sensitive findings.

  3. 03

    Keep the guarantees honest.

    Test reset guards, key verification and user revocation. Distinguish an emulator pass from a real-phone pass, and an estimate from a billing record.

OWNERSHIP / RESPONSIBILITY

Clear code.
Clear terms.

Privacy and local control

Rookstride adds no cloud account, analytics or remote crash-upload service. The app speaks directly to the VPS you select. Optional traffic estimates remain on that VPS and are read over SSH.

The website has no forms, tracking scripts, advertising cookies or third-party font requests. Following GitHub or upstream links takes you to those independent services, with their own policies.

Licenses

Original Android administration code, this website and the Rookstride brand are GPL-3.0-or-later. Embedded strongSwan retains its GPL-2.0-or-later notices; the combined app is distributed under GPL version 3 or later. Gateway scripts retain their MIT license.

LicenseUpstream noticesSecurity policy

Independent by design

strongSwan, AdGuard Home, Unbound and filter authors maintain their own projects. Rookstride is not affiliated with strongSwan, AdGuard, OnePlus or Amnezia. Product names and upstream marks belong to their respective owners.

ROOK / ORIGINAL MARK

A FACE FOR THE JOURNEY

Meet the little
red navigator.

Rook is our original bird mark: a clear silhouette, a bright red head and an eye on the next turn. In his stories he carries a lamp, a map and a habit of helping.

His home is Lantern Harbor, a fictional city. His adventures are a human invitation to understand the project, not a technical promise.

Brand and story materials follow GPL-3.0-or-later. Keep modified versions distinguishable and avoid implying official endorsement. The illustrations are original AI-generated artwork created for this project; the revised SVG mark remains code-native. The 0.2.0-alpha3 APK includes the revised mark, helper roles and offline worlds. Its UI report distinguishes device-voice fixtures from audible narration testing.
